backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing a poetry platform with user profiles, poems (text/image), collections, notifications, and role-based access control using mixins for authorization and blob storage.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three implemented features: permanent footer with creator attribution, admin privilege assignment interface, and in-app notification system for new poetry.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including routing, components, pages, hooks, and utilities for the Gojri poetry platform with authentication, notifications, and admin features.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining light and dark theme color palettes using OKLCH color space for warm earth tones and literary aesthetic.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with document title 'International Gojri Maa Boli Adab' and root div for React application mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, poem detail, admin form, collection manager, and admin panel, wrapped with QueryClient provider and UserProfileSetup.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component with sticky header containing navigation (Home, Add Poem, Collections, Admin Panel), authentication controls, notification bell, and footer displaying 'Made by SC05 Sohail Ch' with caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button component managing Internet Identity login/logout with loading states and query cache clearing on logout.
frontend/src/components/NotificationBell: Bell icon button with unread notification count badge that opens a popover containing the NotificationPanel component.
frontend/src/components/NotificationPane: Displays a scrollable list of notifications with loading states, empty states, and the ability to mark individual notifications as read using a check button.
frontend/src/components/PoemCard.tsx: Renders a clickable card for poems with two layouts: image poems show a cover image with overlay text, while text poems display title, author, date, and content preview with collection badges.
frontend/src/components/UserProfileSetup: Shows a modal dialog prompting authenticated users without a profile to enter their name, blocking interaction until profile setup is complete.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor instance based on authentication state, initializing with identity when authenticated and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context with login/logout functionality, identity management, and status tracking through a React context provider.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend operations including poems, collections, search, user profiles, notifications, and admin functions with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global styles with warm earth-tone color schemes for light and dark modes using CSS custom properties, and sets up font families (Inter for body, Lora/Crimson Text for headings).
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up the React root with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminForm.tsx: Admin form page for submitting poems (text or image) with Internet Identity authentication, file upload with progress tracking, and success feedback.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin panel page for assigning user roles (admin) via Principal ID, with authentication checks and access control validation.
frontend/src/pages/CollectionManager.tsx: Collection management page allowing authenticated users to create collections, add/remove poems to/from collections, and delete collections with dialog-based poem selection.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Main homepage displaying all poems with search functionality, collection filtering, and debounced search queries to browse the Gojri poetry collection.
frontend/src/pages/PoemDetail.tsx: Poem detail page showing full poem content (text or image), metadata, associated collections, and download options for both image and generated text-based images.
frontend/src/utils/downloadHelpers.ts: Utility functions for downloading images from URLs or Blobs and sanitizing filenames for safe file downloads.
frontend/src/utils/formatDate.ts: Utility function to convert nanosecond timestamps (Time type) to human-readable date strings in 'Month Day, Year' format.
frontend/src/utils/poemImageGenerator.ts: Generates a shareable PNG image of a poem on a canvas with decorative borders, gradients, and typography, including title, content, author, and branding.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes using OKLCH, typography fonts (Inter, Crimson Text, Lora), animations, and design tokens for the application theme.
project_state.json: Project state tracking document for a Gojri Poetry Platform, listing implemented features (footer, admin assignment, notifications) and pending feature requests.
